mcqs.question: Who was elected Vice-President of India in September 2025 as the NDA candidate, defeating B. Sudershan Reddy?
mcqs.explanation: C.P. Radhakrishnan was elected Vice-President of India as the NDA candidate after defeating B. Sudershan Reddy. Shigeru Ishiba was associated with the 15th India–Japan Summit, while Safeena Husain and Arindam Bagchi were in the news for different matters.

mcqs.question: Who was the Prime Minister of Japan associated with the 15th India–Japan Summit held in Tokyo?
mcqs.explanation: Shigeru Ishiba, the Prime Minister of Japan, was associated with the 15th India–Japan Summit held in Tokyo. C.P. Radhakrishnan was elected Vice-President of India, Navinchandra Ramgoolam visited Varanasi, and Abiy Ahmed inaugurated the GERD.
